request.style: English, male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, upright bass, mournful violin, soft percussion, solemn and tragic mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A twenty-one year old sat on the throne
In Jerusalem, his mother was Hamutal
He reigned for eleven years in that place
But he did what was evil in the Lord's sight
He did not humble himself before Jeremiah
Who spoke from the mouth of the Lord

[Chorus]
He rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar
Who had made him swear an oath by God
He stiffened his neck and hardened his heart
Against turning back to the Lord God of Israel

[Verse]
Zedekiah sent for the prophet in secret
Asked him to hide nothing from his eyes
But Jeremiah said if I tell you
You will surely put me to death
The king swore in private as the Lord lives
Who gave us breath, I will not kill you

[Chorus]
He rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar
Who had made him swear an oath by God
He stiffened his neck and hardened his heart
Against turning back to the Lord God of Israel

[Verse]
If you surrender to the officers of Babylon
Your life will be spared and this city will stand
But if you do not surrender to them
This city will be burned down by the Chaldeans
You yourself will not escape from their hands
He sent envoys to Egypt for horses
Broke the covenant and gave his hand in pledge

[Chorus]
He rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar
Who had made him swear an oath by God
He stiffened his neck and hardened his heart
Against turning back to the Lord God of Israel

[Outro]
The Chaldeans pursued him in the plains of Jericho
They captured the king and brought him to Riblah
They slaughtered his sons before his eyes
Put out his eyes and bound him in bronze shackles
He kept him in prison until the day of his death
